name: @blackbyte/raycast-spacetime
title: Spacetime
description: Track how much time you spend in each macOS space, with inactivity detection and CSV export.
author: olivier_bossel

commands.name: tracker
commands.title: Refresh Menubar
commands.subtitle: Spacetime
commands.description: Menu bar tracker: start/stop a session and record time per macOS space.

commands.name: sessions
commands.title: Spacetime Sessions
commands.subtitle: Spacetime
commands.description: Browse recorded sessions, view per-space breakdowns and export to CSV.

commands.name: spaces
commands.title: Spaces List
commands.subtitle: Spacetime
commands.description: List your macOS spaces: switch to one, or rename it. Names are used everywhere time is shown.

commands.name: name-current
commands.title: Rename Current Space
commands.subtitle: Spacetime
commands.description: Name the space you're currently on.

commands.name: setup
commands.title: Setup Spacetime
commands.subtitle: Spacetime
commands.description: Apply the macOS settings and permissions the extension needs to switch spaces.

commands.name: start-session
commands.title: Start New Spacetime Session
commands.subtitle: Spacetime
commands.description: Start a new time-tracking session (replacing any current one).

commands.name: export-last-session
commands.title: Export Last Spacetime Session
commands.subtitle: Spacetime
commands.description: Export the most recent session to a CSV file in Downloads.

preferences.name: inactivityEnabled
preferences.title: Inactivity Detection
preferences.label: Pause tracking when idle
preferences.description: When enabled, tracking pauses automatically after a period of no keyboard/mouse activity.

preferences.name: inactivityMinutes
preferences.title: Idle Threshold (minutes)
preferences.description: How many minutes of inactivity before tracking auto-pauses.

preferences.name: dailyPrompt
preferences.title: Daily Session Reminder
preferences.label: Ask to start a session once a day
preferences.description: Once a day after 6am, show a prompt offering to start a new session.

preferences.name: autoDailySession
preferences.title: Automatic Daily Session
preferences.label: Record a session automatically every day
preferences.description: Automatically start a new session once a day (when you first use your computer), with no action. The daily reminder is skipped while this is on.
